intro: Wanaka is a hidden gem for family holidays, offering a range of activities and stunning scenery without the crowds of Queenstown. With a budget of $250-450 per day for a family of four, you can enjoy the best of Wanaka without breaking the bank. From discounts on activities to money-saving tips, we've got you covered.

sections.heading: Best-Value Activities in Wanaka
sections.body:
Wanaka has a range of activities to suit all ages and budgets. Puzzling World is a quirky family classic, while a picnic at Rippon Vineyard is a free and relaxing way to enjoy the scenery. In winter, Treble Cone Ski Area offers skiing and snowboarding for older kids.

Lake Wanaka kayak/paddleboard rental is another great way to enjoy the lake, with prices starting from around $20 per hour. The Wanaka Lakeshore walk is a free and easy walk that's suitable for all ages, while the Mt Iron track offers stunning views of the town and lake.

Lake Wanaka kayak/paddleboard rental: from $20 per hour

sections.heading: When to Book for Best Prices
sections.body:
To get the best prices on activities and accommodation in Wanaka, it's a good idea to book in advance. For peak season (December to February), book at least 2-3 months in advance to avoid sold-out activities and high prices.

For off-peak season (March to November), you can often book at shorter notice and still get good prices. Consider visiting in the shoulder season (April to May or September to November) for a more relaxed atmosphere and lower prices.
